cases.observation: A memory-ablation audit offers a four-condition experiment matrix but no trial decisions or results. Which finding is established?

actions.alpha: Only an experimental design is documented; no behavioral effect has been demonstrated.
actions.beta: The matrix proves memory caused a measurable decision shift.

cases.observation: A paper introduces trace-aware evaluation but supplies no controlled reliability comparison with final-answer-only grading. Which inference is justified?

actions.alpha: Trace-aware grading has been experimentally proven more reliable.
actions.beta: It covers additional execution traces but improvement over outcome-only evaluation remains unproven.

cases.observation: A new memory system describes a dozen retrieval configurations and reports their settings, but it supplies no per-condition metrics. What should an evaluator conclude?

actions.alpha: Do not attribute improvement to a retrieval configuration until paired results are available.
actions.beta: Choose the widest retrieval configuration; more settings necessarily prove improvement.

cases.observation: Two AI agents have identical scores, but only one has action logs and measured memory-condition differences. What can be concluded?

actions.alpha: Identical final scores establish that memory had no effect on any behavior.
actions.beta: The measured decision difference may be studied without claiming the overall score improved.

cases.observation: A trading model changes its portfolio decision when its long-term policy memo is hidden, but portfolio returns are not yet available. Which statement best fits the evidence?

actions.alpha: The memo affected the observed decision; whether it improves investment performance is unresolved.
actions.beta: A portfolio decision difference by itself proves positive realized returns.

cases.observation: An execution agent advertises rollback checkpoints but an audit only lists code paths; no crash/recovery traces or outcomes are shown. Which claim is supported?

actions.alpha: The existence of a rollback method proves successful post-crash recovery.
actions.beta: Implementation routes exist, but reliable recovery remains unverified until executed and observed.
